artworks.title: Le train de Berne (The Train for Berne)
artworks.medium: brush with brown and black ink and black crayon on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a group of figures mostly showing upper bodies and heads. Several individuals are gathered around, each in various poses; some leaning forward while others are standing upright. The people have roughly sketched facial features with eyes and noses visible. Most wear headgear like hats or helmets and long bulky coats. The environment is minimal, with lines hinting at a structure or enclosed area, maybe a room or tent. No visible jewelry or distinct objects are shown. The background consists of lining and shading, suggesting a crowded or busy setting for a meeting or gathering.

artworks.title: a) Le replis boche (recto); b) Sketch for the Figure of the German (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush with black ink, watercolor, and black crayon on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a soldier standing beside a cart, with abstractly rendered figures nearby. The soldier is depicted in full uniform with a cap, and the other figures are sketched more abstractly. The cart in the background is outlined simply. The drawing employs a minimalist style, focusing on the main figure and using sketch-like outlines for additional narrative elements.

artworks.title: a) L'Englise de leurs peres (recto); b) Man with Cigarette (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
b) brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a group of children. The man is on the right side, wearing a hat and overcoat, with one arm extended. The children are in front of him, looking up. The man has a serious expression and a beard. The children are simple in appearance. There are other figures in the background, suggesting a crowd. The man is near some steps or a flat structure, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Le demobilise
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a man and a woman in a monochrome drawing. The man is on the left, standing and hunched over an item. He has short hair and a mustache, wearing loose-fitting clothing. The woman on the right stands upright with her hands extended holding a flat object. She has neat hair, possibly in a low bun, and is wearing a long dress. There are bags and a dark garment around them, with a plain background.

artworks.title: En esclavage dans le Nord
artworks.medium: black crayon and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene featuring figures in a historical context. There is a figure seated at the base of a tree looking upwards, another figure standing with a basket, and several figures in the background involved in activity. The figures are rendered in loose brushstrokes with a sketch-like quality, emphasizing movement and emotion. The standing figures carry or rest against objects that suggest labor or travel, such as baskets. The landscape is depicted in earthy tones, with a sparse quality that evokes a sense of hardship or toil.

artworks.title: German Raid on a Village
artworks.medium: brush and black ink, black crayon, and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures marching in a landscape with smoke rising from a burning structure. The scene shows figures moving away from the viewer in an open landscape with fields and distant buildings on fire, marked by large plumes of smoke. The figures are depicted in motion, some holding weapons, and are portrayed with dynamic, sketchy lines. The drawing is done in a minimalistic color palette, with emphasis on contrasts and shading to highlight forms and shapes.

artworks.title: a) La Guerre sous-Marine. L'ecole des Neutres (recto); b) Study of  La Guerre sous-Marine. L'ecole des Neutres (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink, black crayon, and  watercolor on wove paper
b) black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and shapes forming an abstract composition. Dark lines in the center suggest figures, resembling people sitting closely. Broad strokes of blues, grays, and browns create a fluid background. The arrangement of colors and forms evokes a connection to a group at sea or on a shoreline, with the fluid shapes emphasizing movement or flow.

artworks.title: a) Dead German Soldier (recto); b) Head of a Soldier (verso)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink, black crayon, and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a military or combat scene. The image shows a fallen figure on the ground with a rifle nearby. The figure is dressed in a uniform with boots and a military helmet. Two other figures are standing to the right, one observing closely and the other appearing as a mere outline. The background features earthy tones, contributing to the desolate atmosphere of the scene. The sketch-like lines give the drawing an expressive appearance.

artworks.title: En esclavage
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban street scene with figures standing and interacting, bustling with activity. The figures are depicted in a sketch-like manner with minimal, expressive lines suggesting movement. In the background, there are buildings with slanted roofs and vertical lines, adding depth to the scene. Shading and light ink wash are used to give dimension and texture to the drawing, enhancing the urban setting.

artworks.title: a) Bolo pacha (recto); Study for Bolo pacha (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink and black crayon, with corrections by the artist in white opaque watercolor, on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two individuals. On the left, one person is seated on a chair, leaning forward with their arms on their knees. The person is shirtless, with bold facial features and short, neat hair. They are fully drawn from the upper body down to the legs, with a pair of shoes near their feet. On the right, another individual stands in flowing robes, wearing a wide-brimmed cap that partially conceals their face. The standing figure holds a bundle in their arms. The background is simple, with faint vertical lines hinting at a wall or backdrop.

artworks.title: Les chefs (The Chefs)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with three military figures. The first figure on the left is a standing soldier facing slightly to the right, wearing a helmet and a uniform with a large pack on his back. The second figure is seated on a bag, facing slightly to the right with an intense expression. The third figure in the background on the right wears a similar cap and appears to be kneeling or crouching. The background is lightly sketched with minimal details of rocks or other figures, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Mother and Child Visited by Soldier in Hospital
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in a drawing. The first figure is a child seen full-body, standing on a bed, with their body slightly turned. The child has dark, messy hair and minimal facial features. They appear to be wearing a robe. Beside the child, a partially visible figure is seated on the bed with a blanket. The third figure, an adult, is standing and wearing a hat and long coat. The background shows a bed and possible headboard, sketched with minimal lines on an empty canvas.

artworks.title: La Borne - Verdun (The End - Verdun)
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching on on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene with fallen soldiers. The artwork includes a grave marker inscribed with "VERDUN 11 K." surrounded by two lifeless figures lying on the ground. The background is filled with chaotic, densely drawn lines. The technique used involves intricate and expressive line work. The atmosphere is heavy, capturing the reality of war. The use of monochrome adds to the somber tone of the image.

artworks.title: a) Les Allemandes sont partis (recto); b) Sketch of a Man (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon and watercolor on laid paper
b) black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person standing. They appear to be looking downward. The person has dark hair, which partially covers their face. They are wearing a long dress and dark shoes. In the background, there are few details, including figures kneeling, sitting, and standing far away. Some textures imply natural elements like hills or rocks. The scene appears calm and quiet.

artworks.title: Hiding the "louis"
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing two individuals depicted in full body length. The person on the left is standing with a slight forward lean, dressed in a long coat and wearing a helmet, with lines suggesting facial features obscured by the helmet's construction. Their feet are clad in boots, and they hold an object at their side. On the right, the second person stands upright beside the wall of a structure, with one arm extended outwards. This individual wears a flowing garment with a head covering adorned with some sort of protrusion on the top. The facial features appear stylized in a simplistic manner, suggesting sharp angles. On the ground near this figure are rounded shapes that could represent rocks or similar objects. The background reveals a lightly sketched area with subtle outlines, giving a sense of an outdoor setting with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Sur la ligne de feu
artworks.medium: black crayon with brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a vehicle with a cross flag amid a barren landscape. The drawing features a vehicle positioned on rough terrain. The vehicle is adorned with a flag showing a cross. A figure is sketched on the right side, wearing a hat and bundled in a coat with a scarf. The background is sparse, focusing attention on the vehicle and figure. The artist's use of lines and shading brings depth and texture to the elements within this minimalistic composition.

artworks.title: a) La Borne, Verdun (recto); b) Wounded Soldier and First-Aid Man (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush with black and gray ink and black crayon over graphite on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a prone figure among foliage and a directional marker. The image features a figure lying face down, partially obscured by dense vegetation. Beside the figure is a column-like object with the words "VERDUN 11 K" inscribed on it. The drawing is rendered in black and white, using expressive lines to create texture and movement. The composition contrasts the solid form of the milestone with the softer, flowing lines of the natural elements around it. The title "La Borne" is handwritten at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: Poilu Acknowledging German Soldier
artworks.medium: black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals, both depicted in full body. On the left, a person is standing slightly bent forward, holding something in their hands. This person appears to be wearing a helmet and a thick coat. Their facial features are detailed, with a focused expression. On the right stands another individual, facing the first person, appearing relaxed. They are wearing a hat with a short brim and a simple shirt with long sleeves. This person's facial features include a short beard. The background consists of abstract lines and shapes. No additional objects or jewelry are visible. At the bottom, there is text in French which reads: "Eh bien vrai! Je ne te croyais pas si malade....."

artworks.title: a) Le baiser du drapeau (recto); b) Study of Le baiser du drapeau (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon on laid paper
b) black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts two full-bodied figures in the foreground. The figure on the right is a soldier, while the figure on the left is a person in a dress. The soldier's head is slightly tilted downward as he interacts with a flag or draped cloth. The person in a dress appears to be holding the opposite end of the flag or cloth. The soldier's facial features are obscured by shadow, and the person in a dress is drawn in profile. Text is handwritten across the top, pertaining to Marshal Pétain. The background includes rough sketches of additional figures and a distant group or crowd.

artworks.title: a) Refugees (recto); b) No 2 (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink and blue crayon on wove paper
b) blue crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a side view of two individuals, an adult and a child, drawn in black and blue lines against a cream background. The adult is seen in a standing and slightly hunched posture, facing right, with both hands placed near their waist. They have an ambiguous dark outline where facial features reside, and their hair appears covered mostly by a hood or shawl draped over their head and shoulders down to their feet. The child stands close to the adult, gazing up at them, with a hand possibly clinging to the adult's garment. The child’s head is lifted, and the dark hair is flowing down the back. The background is minimally detailed, with faint sketches suggesting other figures or objects scattered towards the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Poilu and German Prisoners
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows four figures, mostly focusing on their upper bodies. Three individuals are seated and one is standing in the background. The seated figures lean slightly forward and appear engaged in conversation or activity. They wear uniform-like clothing and caps. One person has "PG" on their clothing. The standing figure also wears similar attire and observes the group. The plain background highlights the sketched figures, with a sack or bag on the ground near the seated individuals.

artworks.title: Discharged from Military Service
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. One person on the left is standing, tilting slightly forward. They have short dark hair and a mustache, with emphasis on the facial hair. The clothing is loosely drawn. The second person on the right is seated or kneeling, facing left. Their head is vague, with a serene facial expression. They wear a head covering and a high neck garment like a dress or cloak. They are surrounded by undefined textiles, perhaps bedding or fabric. The background suggests interior furnishings, possibly a bedroom. The image is monochrome with simple lines and shading.

artworks.title: Reims 9bre 1918
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash over black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a collapsed structure and debris in the foreground. A row of smaller buildings is shown extending to the right, becoming smaller in the distance. The horizon is low in the composition with a few distant structures visible. In the background, a taller upright structure stands out, possibly a tower. The overall color palette includes black, beige, and muted browns with sketchy lines to convey detail and texture in a mostly monochromatic scheme.

artworks.title: Sur le Rhin
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows two people standing from head to toe. On the left, a person with a long weapon slung over their shoulder is looking towards the other person. The person wears a helmet, a uniform with a long coat. On the right, another person faces the first person. Both people wear caps and uniform-like outfits. The background is minimal, suggesting a distant landscape or horizon. The drawing is simple with minimal shading, focusing on the outlines of the figures.
